name: obsidian
description: Connect Obsidian to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Obsidian MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Obsidian to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with notes in your vault using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Obsidian workspace.
Find anything in Obsidian that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review notes in your vault in Obsidian.
